name: Wind Step
additional_info: Jump while airborne to double jump, leaving behind a wind pad that other players can also use. Alternatively, jumping while sliding down a slope or near a cliff edge will perform a Gale Leap that propels you forwards. 1s CD. While in combat, this ability costs Ether to use.
desc: Create a step of wind below you when jumping in the air. Jumping while sliding down a slope or off a cliff launches you forwards.
